instruction.text: After Easter lunch, the Wright family have eaten 3/4 of a lamb shoulder. Work out how much of the lamb shoulder is left.
An architect measures a room to be 3 metres tall. She plans to decrease the height by <mat>3/5</mat> metres. Work out what the new height of the room will be.

atoms.a: First, convert the current height of the room into an improper fraction with a denominator of 5.
Write the answer as a mixed number.

instruction.text: Mandy is having a party and has seven pizzas to share with her friends. Together, they eat 5 whole pizzas and 5/8 of another. Work out how much is left.

atoms.a: First, convert <mat>5 5/8</mat> into an improper fraction.
Convert the total number of pizzas into an improper fraction with the same denominator.
Write the answer as a mixed number.
